BarcodeDetector wraps Vision's VNDetectBarcodesRequest (broad symbology set: QR, PDF417, Aztec, DataMatrix, 1D) and emits rect-based DetectionResult(kind: .pii(.barcode)) with VNBarcodeObservation.confidence; matchedText carries the decoded payload when Vision extracts one. The 'barcode.vision' string itself lives in PIIDetector.defaultRuleID(for: .barcode) (PIIDetector.swift:419) — the engine's canonical kind-to-ruleID mapping, applied by ensureRationales to any PIIMatch lacking a detector-built rationale. As of Resecta cbbf0c8 the barcode path flows rect-based through DetectionOrchestrator rather than through PIIDetector.detect, so the string reaches a MatchAuditRecord only via that mapping. Row added by the W-I1 reconciliation (speed S01, 2026-06-10): the emit-string scan surfaces the switch arm, and the unreachable_fallbacks alternative was rejected because nothing overrides 'barcode.vision' — it is the only ruleID assigned to the .barcode kind (unlike ssn.regex, which SSNStateMachine supersedes). 4-part rule_id puts the load-bearing mechanism in the algorithm slot ('vision'), parity with pii.cc.luhn.v1 / pii.name.nltagger.v1. source_artifact null: Vision framework, no pipeline gazetteer.

Note Swift emits ruleID='dea.letter-check' with structuralValidator signal name='dea.checksum'; the catalog rule_id 'pii.dea.checksum.v1' aligns with the structural-validator semantic per kickoff.

DRAW-3 (plan resecta-sec-draw-perf-2026-05-11 §4; decisions.md Batch 7 Q1). SignatureHeuristicDetector finds OCR blocks labeled signature/sign here/signed/authorized signature, defines a candidate rect beside or below the label, and scores it with a pure-Swift 128x64 Sobel pass (ink-density + curvature thresholds, both must clear) — emitting DetectionResult(kind: .pii(.signatureCandidate)). Triage-only by design: DetectionOrchestrator routes .signatureCandidate to pendingTriage, never auto-applied, and PIICategory(piiKind:) returns nil for it. The 'signature.heuristic' string lives in PIIDetector.defaultRuleID(for: .signatureCandidate) (PIIDetector.swift:422), whose adjacent comment notes the kind is never emitted via PIIDetector but the switch is exhaustive over PIIKind — i.e. the string is the canonical ruleID for the kind, reachable only through the kind-to-ruleID mapping as of Resecta cbbf0c8. Row added by the W-I1 reconciliation (speed S01, 2026-06-10) on the same grounds as pii.barcode.vision.v1: nothing overrides this string, so the unreachable_fallbacks set (reserved for arms a real detector always supersedes) would mischaracterize it. 4-part rule_id with the mechanism in the algorithm slot ('heuristic' — confidence is an uncalibrated density/curvature blend per the module header). source_artifact null: pure-Swift heuristic, no pipeline gazetteer.
